paraphrase: Within a finite two-phase material-turnover signature, a vitalist interpretation, a process-only interpretation and a non-soul substantial-unity interpretation have exactly the same material membership, life, integration, self-maintenance and causal-continuity facts. The data alone therefore do not determine either substantial unity or the irreducible soul-as-form principle. This is logical underdetermination in a toy language, not a metaphysical or empirical refutation of vitalism.
